title: Flashcards: Capitals, Africa
intro: Flip each card about Africa. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: What is the capital of Gambia?
cards.explain: Banjul is the capital of Gambia.

cards.front: What is the capital of Guinea?
cards.explain: Conakry is the capital of Guinea.

cards.front: What is the capital of Comoros?
cards.explain: Moroni is the capital of Comoros.

cards.front: What is the capital of Morocco?
cards.explain: Rabat is the capital of Morocco.

cards.front: What is the capital of Mali?
cards.explain: Bamako is the capital of Mali.

cards.front: What is the capital of Mauritania?
cards.explain: Nouakchott is the capital of Mauritania.

cards.front: What is the capital of Malawi?
cards.explain: Lilongwe is the capital of Malawi.

cards.front: What is the capital of Namibia?
cards.explain: Windhoek is the capital of Namibia.

cards.front: What is the capital of Sudan?
cards.explain: Khartoum is the capital of Sudan.

cards.front: What is the capital of Somalia?
cards.explain: Mogadishu is the capital of Somalia.

cards.front: What is the capital of Eswatini?

cards.front: What is the capital of Togo?
cards.explain: Lomé is the capital of Togo.
